author: Hailer Oy
description: Customer dashboard — assets, support tickets, contacts, opportunities, ManikinPC, rentals, online orders, and trips/IHS visits, all in one place for any client.
versionDescription: Asset cards now show a representative photo for their product family (e.g. the '431-iSGHP' asset shows the actual iSGHP unit) — helps identify assets by sight instead of by model number alone. Backed by a new small reference dataset (one photo per product family, not per physical unit) — cards for families without a photo yet just show no image, nothing breaks.
